title: Delhi DSSSB New Latest Result 2026
postName: DSSSB Various Recruitment Results / Cutoff / Marks 2026
vacancyDetails: DSSSB result notices for various exams and post codes released in 2026 including TGT, PGT, Nursery teacher and other recruitment posts.
qualification: As per respective DSSSB recruitment notification and post code requirements.
ageLimit: As per the respective post-specific DSSSB advertisement.
applicationFee: No application fee to check results and score card; as per respective recruitment form when applying.
selectionProcess: Written exam → result / merit list → e-dossier / document verification → final selection as applicable
documentsRequired: Roll number, date of birth, class 10 roll number / year, application number and e-dossier documents if shortlisted
howToApply:
1. Visit the official DSSSB result portal.
2. Open the latest result PDF or login section.
3. Search by roll number, name or post code.
4. Download the result, cutoff or marks.
5. Follow the e-dossier or document verification instructions if shortlisted.
shortDescription: Delhi DSSSB New Latest Result 2026 has been released for various posts. Download result, cutoff, marks and score card from the official DSSSB portal.
content:
Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the latest result notices for various examinations across 2026.

Applicants and candidates who appeared in TGT, PGT, Nursery, technical, teaching and other DSSSB examinations can check their result, marks, cut-off and score card through the official portal.

The result is generally published as a PDF notice and in some cases candidates can login to the DSSSB portal using their date of birth, class 10 roll number, year of passing and password to access detailed marks and score card information.
